stage: Official reference silhouette revision, manually authored review models
references: All 12 official basic-form images visually inspected in ArtSource/Roster/ReferencesV2/board-0.jpg through board-2.jpg; compared with previous model previews. Source page/image mapping is in ReferencesV2/sources.json.
common_improvements: Species-specific proportions and joint locations replace the shared generic body.
Closed curved petal, feather and bat-ear surfaces replace flat triangular leaves.
Smooth continuous skin joins preserve materials and up to four interpolated bone weights.
Individual eye shape, iris colour, smile, claws and flower anatomy are authored per character.

verification.blender_geometry: 12 species built and rendered in an isolated temporary folder
verification.pose_smoke: 32 sampled poses per species across all eight clips completed without Blender errors; this is not the final contact/collision test
verification.visual_review: 12 new 640-pixel three-quarter views inspected; disconnected bird thighs and hard skin junctions corrected
verification.runtime: Root agent performs final generation, export, animation-bound and player checks

characters.changes: Four layered golden wings, hooked eagle beak, red/gold crest, light breast feathers, golden ankle rings, talons and long ruby-marked golden tail.

limits: These are authored stylized models, not game-extracted meshes or final professional sculpts.
Official illustrations were inspected; Digimon Masters motion was not independently inspected for these 12 species.
The shared existing eight animation clips are retained; model-specific motion timing and facial shape keys need further iteration.
